full_judgment: 9. Mr Md Nawab Ali, the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the opposite party, has submitted that the impugned judgment is a good, reasonable and proper judgment of affirmance passed by the learned Appellate Judge, in which interference by this Court is not desirable at all as there are a good number of decisions of our apex Court that the High Court Division in its revisional jurisdiction should not interfere with the concurrent findings of facts of the trial Court and the lower appellate Court until and unless there is serious error of law leading to error in the decision occasioning failure of justice or there is non reading and misreading of evidences on record. He prays that the Rule be discharged.
